sloka: त्वयि सन्निहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता ।किम् पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवम् मरणम् एव मे ॥२-२०-४१॥
transliteration: tvayi sannihite'pyevamahamāsaṁ nirākṛtā ।kim punaḥ proṣite tāta dhruvam maraṇam eva me ॥2-20-41॥

translations.english: O child even when you are nearby I am neglected like this. What to say when you are banished. Death is certain to me.
